data.gender_notes: Bijon is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Bijon is a Sanskrit name derived from the word 'bija', which means seed. This name is a tribute to the divine creator Lord Brahma, who is believed to have created the universe from a seed. The name Bijon is thus a symbol of creation, potential, and growth. The name Bijon carries the meaning “Lord of seeds” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Bijon usually hope their child will grow to embody lord of seeds and live with faith, good character and purpose.
